events.narration: Cells from m1_out_1/2/3 arrive at m1b_cells_in_1/2/3 and merge. They were labelled per chamber in Module 1, so they can share one line.
Quench: medium joins the cells at the T-junction and the serpentine mixes it in, neutralising the detach reagent.
Wash the cells into clean buffer; the old liquid goes to waste. (Method TBC: DLD array, spiral channel or density cushion.)
Through the 30 um pillar filter to the QC window: clumps stay behind, single cells go on.
Count: the QC window reads the cell concentration and viability.
Resuspend in dextran buffer at the dilution that gives about 0.1 cells per capsule in Module 2; the operator sets it from the count.

log.message: simulated counter at m1b_qc_window_1: 1,086 cells/uL, 94.3% viable
m1b_resuspend_1 dilution set to 1x: counted 1,086 cells/uL, below the ~1,949 cells/uL Module 2 needs for 0.1 cells per capsule; dilution can't fix that, so no extra dilution (minimum buffer only)
cells to Module 2: blocked: too dilute - concentrate 1.8x: 1,086 cells/uL gives 0.056 cells per capsule at Module 2's flows (target 0.1)
stopped before Module 2: the cells stay in m1b_resuspend_1 for a person to fix (too dilute - concentrate 1.8x: 1,086 cells/uL gives 0.056 cells per capsule at Module 2's flows (target 0.1))

scenario.name: m1b_cellprep_too_dilute
scenario.description: Too few cells per uL: even undiluted they give well under 0.1 cells per capsule, so the safety checker blocks the hand-off and says how much to concentrate.

reasons: too dilute - concentrate 1.8x: 1,086 cells/uL gives 0.056 cells per capsule at Module 2's flows (target 0.1)
